product_role: Passive regional creature that rewards patient noncombat interaction.

identity.shape_grammar: A squat four-legged root-nosed browser carrying three uneven shelf-like moss pads and a curled twig tail.
identity.palette: Warm umber body, fern green pads, small cream mushrooms, and dark berry nose.
identity.player_loop: Observe it forage, offer a sweet berry, and receive one bounded vanilla-material forage gift after a cooldown.

explicit_non_goals: No taming, mounting, breeding, inventory, custom GUI, combat role, or permanent owner
No copied creature silhouette, texture language, animation, sound, name, or lore
No dependency on another Forest Wave feature
No natural spawning until server stress qualification passes
dependencies: Minecraft Bedrock behavior and resource packs
Native entity components and animation controllers
extension_interfaces: Family tag ccoriginal_cc:mossback for later original encounter selection
Loot table may later include independently authored progression ingredients

gameplay.interaction: Consume one berry, play a short forage response, and drop exactly one bounded gift if off cooldown.
gameplay.defense: Flee the last attacker for a bounded duration; never retaliate.
gameplay.loot: Ordinary death loot and interaction gift use separate original loot tables based on vanilla materials.

multiplayer.cooldown_owner: Entity property shared by all players
multiplayer.contention: Only the first valid interaction during the ready state consumes an item and emits a gift
multiplayer.late_join: Observes the entity's current cooldown state

persistence.restart_recovery: A cooling entity remains cooling or safely returns ready without duplicating a gift; no player state exists.

cleanup.cleanup_function: Removes only tagged Mossback test entities

required_tests: Blockbench source and native geometry round trip
texture, geometry, animation, controller, client, and behavior reference validation
idle, walk, forage, interaction, flee, damage, and death state checks
permitted_creative_latitude: Original proportions, pad construction, texture expression, animation poses, cooldown feedback, and vanilla-material loot weights
